notes.title: Version 3.21 Update list
notes.notes:
1. Fixed the bug of calendar.

2. Optimize the reading experience in the carriage.

3. Optimize a large number of translation.

4. Fixed the bug of Auto Save System. Now the game will auto save when you sleep in the carriage.

5. Fixed the bug of Imperial City.

6. Changed some pictures and offered a smoother experience.

7. Turned on the combat experience sharing system, all teammates can get EXP from each battle.

(Today's translation is translated by myself. So some places may not be accurate. )

notes.title: Version 3.17 Update list
notes.notes:
1. Corrected some wrong characters in text and UI, re-proofread some text.

2. Fixed some crashing bugs.

3. Now credit list will be automatically closed when finish scrolling.

4. The cursor could coincide with the event points now.

5. Support Power has been removed from stores. The great demon (adult) could learn the  skill at level 25.

6. Fixed an issue where achievements could be wrongly unlocked.

4. Fixed the unrecognizable characters in the scenario of Tower of the Eternity, also put  the sentences into right order.
